ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future case and Walz's proposal to overhaul the system.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective is the current system in preventing fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for reform in the Medicaid system. By analyzing public records and following the money, we can shed light on the scope of the problem and identify potential solutions.
